info.title: Praxicraft Assess Public API
info.description:
Programmatic API for organisation integrations with Praxicraft Assess.

All endpoints live under `/api/v1/public/` and require a bearer-token API key.

## Authentication

Create keys in **Assess → API Keys** (Live or Test mode) and include them on every request:
```
Authorization: Bearer ct_live_<your-key>
```
Test-mode keys use `ct_test_` and only see test assessments, invites, and webhooks.

## API Key Scopes

Scopes limit what a key can access. A key with **no scopes selected has full access** (legacy keys). Create narrow-scoped keys for each integration.

| Scope | Access granted |
|---|---|
| `organisation:read` | Org info, billing entitlements, usage, health, team, squads, member invites, audit log |
| `organisation:write` | Limited PATCH `/org/`, hiring squad CRUD and membership (Growth+) |
| `assessments:read` | List and retrieve assessments |
| `assessments:write` | Create, update, duplicate assessments; attach/replace/remove tasks |
| `invitations:read` | List candidate invitations |
| `invitations:write` | Create, remind, and cancel invitations |
| `candidates:read` | Candidate results and session breakdowns |
| `tasks:read` | List and retrieve custom (org-owned) tasks |
| `tasks:write` | Create, update, and delete custom tasks |
| `pipelines:read` | List and retrieve hiring pipelines and enrollments |
| `pipelines:write` | Create/update linear pipelines, enroll, advance, notes |
| `webhooks:read` | List registered webhook destinations |
| `webhooks:write` | Register, test, and retry webhook destinations |
| `interviews:read` | List interviews, analysis, replay, templates |
| `interviews:write` | Create, cancel, reschedule, and share interviews |
| `assistant:write` | CLI Ask AI / `POST /assistant/chat/` (Starter+) |

**Insufficient scope error:**
```json
HTTP 403
{ "error": { "message": "This API key does not have the 'assessments:read' scope.", "code": "INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE" } }
```

Each operation lists its **Required scope** in the description.

## IP allowlists

Each key can have an optional CIDR allowlist, set per key in **Assess → Developer → API Keys**. Empty list = any IP. When set, requests from outside those networks return HTTP 403:

```json
HTTP 403
{ "error": { "message": "This API key is not allowed from this IP address.", "code": "IP_NOT_ALLOWED" } }
```

## Rate limits

Limits are **per organisation per hour** (shared across all API keys) and scale with plan:

| Plan | Read (GET) | Write (POST / PATCH / DELETE) |
|---|---|---|
| Starter | 500 / hour | 100 / hour |
| Growth | 2,000 / hour | 400 / hour |
| Enterprise | 10,000 / hour | 2,000 / hour |

Bulk invite (`POST /assessments/{slug}/invites/bulk/`) is additionally capped at **20 requests / hour** per organisation.

Successful responses include `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. Rate-limit errors return HTTP 429 with code `RATE_LIMITED` and a `Retry-After` header.

Every successful **GET** includes top-level `meta` with `plan`, `invite_limit`, `invites_used`, and `invites_remaining`.

## Response format

Successful responses return the resource directly (not wrapped in a status envelope). Errors return `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`.

get.description:
Returns assessments for your organisation (all statuses by default). Pass `status=active|draft|archived` to narrow the list, or `status=all` to be explicit. Use `search` for a case-insensitive title match. The top-level `meta` object includes your plan invite quota (`plan`, `invite_limit`, `invites_used`, `invites_remaining`).

### Responses

| Status | When |
|--------|------|
| `200` | Paginated list of assessments plus `meta` quota object |
| `404` | Not used — empty list returns `200` with `results: []` |

**Authentication & rate limits (all endpoints)**

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| `401` | `INVALID_API_KEY` | Missing or invalid bearer token |
| `401` | `EXPIRED_API_KEY` | API key past its optional `expires_at` |
| `403` | `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` | API key lacks the required scope for this operation |
| `403` | `IP_NOT_ALLOWED` | Client IP is outside this key's CIDR allowlist |
| `429` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limit exceeded — plan-tiered reads/writes per organisation per hour |

post.description:
Creates a new assessment in **draft** status. Attach tasks with `POST /assessments/{slug}/tasks/attach/`, then set `status: active` via `PATCH /assessments/{slug}/update/` before inviting candidates.

> **Required scope:** `assessments:write`

### Responses

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| `201` | — | Draft assessment created |
| `400` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Missing title or invalid fields |
| `403` | `ASSESSMENT_LIMIT_REACHED` | Plan assessment quota exhausted |
| `403` | `PLAN_REQUIRED` | Recording feature needs a higher plan |

patch.description:
Partially updates assessment configuration. Send **only** the fields you want to change (e.g. `{ "status": "archived" }`). Do not paste OpenAPI placeholder values like `"<string>"` or leave unused fields set — they will overwrite real data.

Path `{slug}` must be the URL-safe **slug** (or UUID `id`) from create/list — **not** the assessment title.

Common fields: `title`, `description`, `status` (`draft` | `active` | `archived`), `time_limit_minutes`, `passing_score`, proctoring flags.

> **Required scope:** `assessments:write`

### Responses

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| `200` | — | Updated assessment returned |
| `400` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | Invalid field value |
| `404` | — | Assessment not found |

**Authentication & rate limits (all endpoints)**

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| `401` | `INVALID_API_KEY` | Missing or invalid bearer token |
| `401` | `EXPIRED_API_KEY` | API key past its optional `expires_at` |
| `403` | `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` | API key lacks the required scope for this operation |
| `403` | `IP_NOT_ALLOWED` | Client IP is outside this key's CIDR allowlist |
| `429` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limit exceeded — plan-tiered reads/writes per organisation per hour |

post.description:
Creates a unique assessment link for one candidate. **Idempotent:** if the email was already invited, or if `external_id` matches an existing invite on this assessment, returns the existing invitation with HTTP `200` (not `201`). Set `send_email: true` to dispatch the email immediately. `extra_time_percent` must be 0, 25, 50, or 100. Optional `tags` are stored on the invitation. Counts against your monthly invite quota unless you are on the enterprise plan.

### Responses

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| `201` | — | New invitation created |
| `200` | — | Invitation already exists for this email (idempotent) |
| `400` | `ASSESSMENT_NOT_ACTIVE` | Assessment is draft or archived |
| `400` | `MISSING_EMAIL` | `email` field is empty |
| `403` | `INVITE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | Monthly invite quota exhausted |
| `404` | — | Assessment slug not found |

**Authentication & rate limits (all endpoints)**

| Status | Code | When |
|--------|------|------|
| `401` | `INVALID_API_KEY` | Missing or invalid bearer token |
| `401` | `EXPIRED_API_KEY` | API key past its optional `expires_at` |
| `403` | `INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE` | API key lacks the required scope for this operation |
| `403` | `IP_NOT_ALLOWED` | Client IP is outside this key's CIDR allowlist |
| `429` | `RATE_LIMITED` | Rate limit exceeded — plan-tiered reads/writes per organisation per hour |

| `403` | `INVITE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | No quota remaining before any invites are created |

tags.name: Public API — Organisation
tags.description:
Organisation profile, billing entitlements, usage series, developer health, team, hiring squads, member invites, and audit log/export.

Read scope: `organisation:read`. Mutations (limited PATCH, squads): `organisation:write`.

Canonical paths use `/org/…`. The US-spelling aliases `/organisation/…` also work at runtime but are omitted from this catalog to avoid duplicates.

tags.name: Public API — Assessments
tags.description:
List, retrieve, and inspect assessments and their task lists.

Read endpoints require `assessments:read`. Assessment results (candidates) require `candidates:read`.

tags.name: Public API — Invitations
tags.description:
Manage candidate invitations across all assessments.

Listing / reading invitations requires `invitations:read`. Creating, reminding, or cancelling invitations requires `invitations:write`.

tags.name: Public API — Results
tags.description:
Retrieve per-invitation and per-assessment candidate results.

Required scope: `candidates:read`

tags.name: Public API — Tasks
tags.description:
Manage custom (organisation-owned) tasks.

Listing / reading tasks requires `tasks:read`. Creating, updating, or deleting tasks requires `tasks:write`.

tags.name: Public API — Pipelines
tags.description:
Manage multi-stage hiring pipelines and candidate enrollments.

Listing / reading pipelines and enrollment status requires `pipelines:read`. Creating/updating linear pipelines, enrolling, advancing, and notes require `pipelines:write`.

tags.name: Public API — Webhooks
tags.description:
Register and verify webhook endpoints for real-time event delivery.

Listing webhooks requires `webhooks:read`. Creating or testing webhooks requires `webhooks:write`.

tags.name: Public API — Interviews
tags.description:
Programmatic live AI and hybrid interviews.

Read endpoints require `interviews:read`. Create, cancel, reschedule, and share require `interviews:write`.

tags.name: Public API — Integrations
tags.description:
Read ATS connection status, inbound webhook URLs, connect URLs, and credential tests.

Required scope: `organisation:read`

tags.name: Public API — Assistant
tags.description:
CLI Ask AI chat proxy (Starter+).

Required scope: `assistant:write`. Rate-limited separately via `public_api_assistant`.
